jobs.title: Commercial Graduate 2027
jobs.summary: Commercial work across pricing, bids and contract delivery in offshore projects. A clear connection between business studies and the maritime industry.
jobs.requirements: Accepts bachelor’s or master’s in business, law, finance or related fields; 0–2 years of experience. English required. Confirm graduation and start dates.

jobs.title: Business Operations Executive
jobs.summary: Work with marine insurance documentation, premiums and client portfolios, collaborating with finance and underwriting teams.
jobs.requirements: Business/economics higher education OR three years of relevant experience. Strong Excel and professional Norwegian and English.

jobs.title: Logistikkoordinator
jobs.summary: Coordinate international transport, delivery schedules and customs documentation, with responsibility for customer projects.
jobs.requirements: Relevant logistics education or experience; the profile also asks for logistics experience. Excel, Norwegian/English and class B driving licence.

jobs.title: Supply Planner
jobs.summary: Translate demand into purchasing plans and manage supplier deliveries, inventory parameters and incoming transport.
jobs.requirements: At least two years of relevant goods-flow planning experience. Supply chain, logistics or economics education; Norwegian and English.

jobs.title: Befrakter · Terminal Berger
jobs.summary: Coordinate freight bookings, load planning and customer updates, balancing transport capacity and commercial performance.
jobs.requirements: Experience in transport, logistics, forwarding or operational planning expected. Norwegian communication and digital planning skills.

jobs.title: Trainee innen innkjøp
jobs.summary: Support purchase orders, supplier administration and commercial agreements alongside your studies.
jobs.requirements: Specifically seeks a first-year master’s student in economics, logistics or technology. A BBA alone does not meet this stated requirement.

jobs.title: Salg- og kundekonsulent
jobs.summary: An early-career banking role focused on insurance sales, customer service and some loan administration. Relevant for business graduates interested in customer-facing commercial work.
jobs.requirements: Completed relevant bachelor’s degree and some telephone-sales experience; insurance sales experience may compensate for education. Fluent Norwegian or another Scandinavian language. Deadline 2 October shown on the matching NAV advert.

jobs.title: Summer Internship 2027
jobs.summary: Summer placements across departments and project teams. Selected staff and support functions are open to a wider range of educational backgrounds.
jobs.requirements: Primarily aimed at science, technology and engineering students. Staff/support opportunities are mentioned, but a specific BBA-compatible placement and its requirements are not confirmed. Check available departments before applying.

jobs.title: Global Finance Trainee 2027
jobs.summary: A two-year finance and business programme with rotations in strategy, controlling, accounting, commercial management and business analysis, including one rotation outside Norway.
jobs.requirements: Mandatory relevant master’s completed by summer 2027, preferably in business administration, finance or economics. Maximum two years of full-time experience, strong academic results and fluent English.

jobs.title: Maritime Advisory Trainee 2027
jobs.summary: A two-year maritime advisory programme with three rotations, client projects and exposure to operational performance, fleet strategy and the wider shipping value chain.
jobs.requirements: Mandatory relevant master’s completed by July 2027, strong analytical and communication skills, interest in maritime work and fluent English. A BBA alone does not meet the stated degree requirement.

jobs.title: Summer Intern 2027
jobs.summary: Work on a mentored independent project in capital management, with possible exposure to risk analysis, fund analysis, valuation, data and responsible investment.
jobs.requirements: At least the first year of higher education completed, good academic results and interest in finance. CV plus transcript or diploma are mandatory. No completed degree or prior finance experience is stated as required.

jobs.title: Summer Internship 2027
jobs.location: Oslo, Karmøy and other Norway locations
jobs.summary: More than 40 internships, including logistics projects, sourcing and trading, logistics performance, energy strategy, inbound shipping and outbound logistics.
jobs.requirements: Minimum three years of completed studies and good academic results. Part-time or voluntary experience is an advantage, not stated as mandatory. Confirm when the three-year threshold is measured.

jobs.title: Deltidsstilling i økonomiavdelingen
jobs.type: Part time · Student · 1–2 days per week
jobs.summary: Student-friendly finance administration covering invoice registration, checks and other administrative tasks, with training and hours adapted to studies.
jobs.requirements: Economics or administration studies are preferred but not mandatory, and the advert says study progress is not decisive. No experience requirement is stated. Deadline is not shown on the original page and may be rolling.
